chat-answer-reasoning.alt: A conversation in Open Chat Interface: the person's question, a collapsed "Reasoning" line above the reply, a reply with a numbered list and a code block, and the composer with the model picker set to "Chat model".
chat-answer-reasoning.caption: A reply with its reasoning folded above it. While a model thinks, a short window shows its latest reasoning.

phone-chat.alt: Open Chat Interface on a phone: the greeting "How can I help you, Administrator?", the message box with an attach button, the model picker and the send button, and buttons for the sidebar, search and a new chat at the top.
phone-chat.caption: On a phone, the sidebar becomes a panel and the composer's controls fold behind one button.

projects-sidebar.alt: The sidebar with a Projects heading: one project expanded to its five most recent conversations and "Show all", a collapsed second project, then the Pinned, Today and Older lists.
projects-sidebar.caption: Project conversations live under their project in the sidebar. Each project has its own instructions and files.

artifact-panel.alt: A reply that created a document artifact, with the artifact docked beside the conversation: the panel header with its title and version, preview and source views, and buttons to copy, download and open it full screen.
artifact-panel.caption: Artifacts open in a docked panel beside the conversation, with versions, the source and a full-screen view.

settings-customization.alt: Settings, Customization: fields for what the assistant should call you and what you do, the chosen traits "concise" and "technical", and a box for anything else it should know, beside a profile card, a Usage Limits card and the keyboard shortcuts.
settings-customization.caption: Settings: personalise replies, choose the appearance, see your limits, and manage history, attachments and devices.

admin-overview-setup.alt: The administration Overview: a setup checklist with 5 of 6 required steps complete, "Set up email delivery" marked Needs attention, optional items for web search, an acceptable use policy and Redis, and totals for users, threads, messages and storage.
admin-overview-setup.caption: The setup checklist shows what is still missing, in order, with a link to each page that fixes it.

admin-model-catalog.alt: Providers & Models, Models tab: the default model chosen from a menu, and the model catalog with an enabled model tagged Vision.
admin-model-catalog.caption: Providers hold the credentials. You choose which of their models join the catalog, and which roles see each one.

admin-roles-access.alt: Roles & access with the User role selected: 8 people with this role, 1 of 1 models visible, and switches for web search, file attachments, share links, temporary chats, branching and projects.
admin-roles-access.caption: Roles & access: one page per role for its models, features, rate limits, storage and budgets.

usage-budgets.alt: Usage budgets: a monthly cost policy scoped to one model and applied to the User role, and a rolling message policy applied to the Restricted role.
usage-budgets.caption: Budgets in messages, tokens or cost, over rolling or calendar windows, scoped to models and applied to roles.

admin-usage-overview.alt: Usage over the last 30 days: counts of conversations, messages sent, people active and attachments, a bar chart of messages per day, and feature-use counts, with tabs for spend, limits and storage.
admin-usage-overview.caption: Usage shows counts and totals per person, model and feature. Nothing on it reads conversation content.

admin-audit-log.alt: The audit log: a search box, action and time filters, an Export button, and a table of sign-in events with their time, actor, action and target.
admin-audit-log.caption: The audit log records administrative and sign-in events, failures included, and exports to CSV.

admin-compliance.alt: Data & storage, Compliance: a scheduled compliance export to an S3-compatible bucket, with Include conversation content switched off and the last run's result, and a list of legal holds naming one person.
admin-compliance.caption: Compliance export writes audit events, and optionally content, to S3 as JSON Lines. Legal holds pause retention and deletion.
